a.text: Sometimes I think that if there really is a Creator responsible for these lands, he's one cruel bastard.
He came up with a really awful disease, where you feel your body being consumed, gradually being replaced by these crystals, helpless to do anything to stop it.
You can feel your very self being removed from your body, day by day.
You can only accept it.
We can only accept it.
And this creation of Oripathy is actually one of the gentler ones across the lands.
The Infected and the uninfected, Nine tells me our persecution is as old as civilization itself.
So... what about poor and rich? Slave and noble?
Foreigner and local? Disabled and able-bodied? Even abnormal and normal...?
A parasitic disease is scary, sure, but Oripathy is only the most obvious, the most prominent of the terrible diseases out there.
The Creator's really awful inventions are poverty, war, bottomless, insatiable greed, the malice and hypocrisy that bring so much suffering, gaps we can never close.
But the truth is, we all know, no Creator came up with that stuff.
Humans, we invented it all on our own.
You and me, we created them.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Good news? Or bad news?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: The good news is that the workshop is still intact, the forest hid it good. The dukes and the Sarkaz never got to use it as an outpost.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: The bad news is, someone's living there. We saw lights. I walked up, identified myself, and the lights went out.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Might be refugees or deserters.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: But they put out the lights... that means they're wary of us.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Our fighters are ready for anything.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: No, let's not be hasty. They might just be cautious, or fearful.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Don't jump to conclusions.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: And anyway, Red's carrying a pretty long blade. Anyone would want to play it safe.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Why don't I go? I'll have a word with them.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: By yourself?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: That's enough. The more men we send, the more nervous they'll be. Besides, if they mean us harm, a few more hands won't make a difference.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: The sky to the south has been red for the past few days. Percival and the others even found an Arts Circle...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We need to move fast.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: There's some risk in that.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: But we made it out of Chernobog.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Fair enough.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We'll be ready to provide support on the sidelines, to make a breakthrough.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: This place was some kind of distillery before the Victorian Reunion settled in?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I can already smell the booze. Romanich would've loved it.

a.text: It certainly was a distillery.
Secret distilleries like this are common enough in Victoria, dodging around punishing taxes imposed by the lords. They could be used to make crude medication for the Infected.
Soaking, mixing, distilling herbs would work, but purification... no way.
I'm starting to admire the Victorian Reunion. They found this place and turned it into a distribution center for medicine.
When did they start calling themselves Reunion and build all this? I'm not sure.
All I know is that the building is just an old house covered in vines now.
No movement around, no lights in the house.
A figure flashes by the window. Red was right, there are people here, and they've spotted me.
I dust of my clothes and fix my hair, trying to look more presentable.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Hello. Anybody home?

a.text: No answer.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Hi, I'm Guard. I've got a team nearby, I'm pretty sure you saw them earlier?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Don't worry, we mean no harm.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: The Victorian Reunion used to use this workshop to make medicine.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: It brought hope to a lot of Infected around Londinium. Its medicine even circulated among the workers in the sewers below the city's industrial districts.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Whoever you are, you know the war is turning a lot more people Infected.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We want to get things going again here, to help them.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Since you're occupying the place...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We need your cooperation.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We can provide medicine or other supplies. We'll trade fair.

a.text: Still, no response.
The doorknob turns, and I grip the hilt of my sword.
After everything we've been through, I know it's pretty likely I'll be staring down a pitchfork or hatchet next. I'm numb to that sort of thing now.
The door opens.

steps.name: Reunion?
steps.text: Reunion, you said?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Your clothes... who are you?

steps.name: Reunion?
steps.text: Mays.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Come in.

a.text: There are more people hiding inside than I guessed. And it's quite a group.
Some of them are obviously Infected, while others leaning against the wall are probably ordinary refugees from the city.
They're all looking over, silently, watching me and the woman in the Victorian Reunion uniform.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Look away, and clear out.

a.text: The crowd falls back, and Mays leads me past their collective gaze.
These people... are terrified.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Are you in charge here?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: This place is under my control.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Let's find a place to talk.

a.text: ...Victorian Reunion... Percival is in Victorian Reunion too.
Our organization doesn't exactly have franchising procedures and once word of the name spread around, the Reunion flag started popping up in all sorts of places.
That also means there have been various acts of violence, acts of revenge, taking place under the Reunion name.
The kind of thing that happened in Chernobog. I start looking at this... Mays.
She seems nervous, her gait is unnatural.
We're in the deepest depths of the workshop.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Here we are. Nobody comes in here.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: So you're Reunion, the real Reunion. You came from the north?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: From... Ursus?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Yes, Ursus, Columbia, and now we're in Victoria.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: That's a ways.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Your uniform, it's...

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I... used a bedsheet.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I ran into a group from Ursus before. They said you dress like this. I think I got the emblem right.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Looks a bit big.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Did you come here just to mock my handiwork?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: So you control this place just because you dressed up in the garb of the infamous 'Reunion'.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Let's get to the point. I don't have much time.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: You want to get this place up and running again? To start making medicine?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Yes, if news got out that Reunion is running the place again...

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Things are more complicated than you know. We have all kinds of people here.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I'm worn out breaking up the daily fights between Infected and uninfected. And you want to make Infected medicine? You might as well blow the place up.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: It's hard to keep a balance between them.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: You're Reunion, aren't you? At least, you claim to be.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: More or less.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Who are your people?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: What else would they be? Homeless Infected, war refugees, people who have lost everything. We all need a roof over our heads.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I first came here with a few other Infected. We found this ruin.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Later, more people came, including some... less than honest folk. We don't take anyone else in anymore.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I'm glad to see you, Reunion comrades, but I don't want to worry anyone here.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Worry?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: That you're conspiring with us to wipe out the uninfected in our midst.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Whether or not it's just a pretext to get us to open our doors to you, we can trade supplies. But let's leave it at that...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: There are plenty of uninfected here, so I get what you're saying.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: But I still think it would be a good idea to talk it over with your people before you come to a decision. As long as we can get back to making medicine here, we can come to a long-term agreement—

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: No, no thank you.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Now, off with you. It was nice meeting you.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: If you want to take this place, you're welcome to it. So long as you can take it.

spans.text: If you want to take this place, you're welcome to it. So long as you

a.text: I can't see her expression behind the mask.
Maybe she's just bluffing.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Alright then.

a.text: But I turned around, nevertheless, getting ready to leave.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Hey, Reunion!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Is Talulah with your group?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: ...She is.

a.text: Another Talulah worshiper?
Sure enough, she's our banner, and that's her cage now too.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I hear she has a nomadic city.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Does that city of hers only take Infected?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: If you haven't been infected, are you allowed to go there?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I've heard... from the passing caravans, I've heard it's a nice place.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: We—There's some people here in less-than-ideal positions, refugees from the wilderness, orphans without a single relative. Talk of that Reunion city has everyone full of hope.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: But... you only stand with the Infected, right?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: A... city?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: There might be a misunderstanding here—

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: Mays! Do you know what they did?

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: Did you tell them to do it?! Have you gone mad?!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: They—Those idiots!

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: He might've been a fighter in the war here! Or some big important figure, here to doom us all!

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: We might be just a couple hours out from a battalion of Sarkaz coming in here to wipe us out!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: You... Are you with Reunion, like Mays?

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: It was you, your people—

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: Those Infected, they killed a Sarkaz in the warehouse!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Bollocks!

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: He... He was Infected too... He's going to explode, right?

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: We need to deal with him!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I'll take a look.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Go, quickly! You should be able to help!

a.text: On the ground lies the corpse of a Sarkaz.
I... know this guy.
The Sarkaz who rode a motorbike, he was a junkman, going around selling stuff he took off the dead.
He was clearly beaten to death, limbs twisted up in unnatural ways.
His hands are tied. He must've tried to break free, judging by his bloody wrists.
The gathered crowd is mostly silent.
I feel a chill, leaving me briefly speechless.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: He... he's dead. The Sarkaz aren't so strong.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Here... the medicine he had on him, and some stale bread.

a.text: The one who did the killing doesn't look well. He indifferently breaks off a piece of bread and hands it to someone beside him.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: He deserved it.

a.text: Someone spits on the ground.
One of them notices me, approaching me while chewing a piece of bread taken off the dead man.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: You! You're with Reunion, aren't you?

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Mays never told us how we could join you!

a.text: I remain silent for a while, calming myself down. I lower his hands for him, spotting the Originium crystals growing on his arm.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Why did you do it?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Did he threaten you? Try to hurt you?

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: Huh? Why?

a.text: It's as if he suddenly loses interest, stumbling over to a nearby crate and taking a seat.

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: When the Sarkaz burned our farm and humiliated my daughter, did anyone ask why?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: He wasn't a soldier. He wasn't a murderous devil from Kazdel. He was just a wandering hawker, selling his wares on the battlefields.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: He... even helped you.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Huh, what does he mean? Was he Reunion too?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I am Reunion.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: You lot must know what it is Reunion fights for.

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Sure, you're fighting for all the Infected!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: This man that you tortured to death, the one who never even got a chance to share his name...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Wasn't he an Infected?

steps.name: Angry Infected
steps.text: But he was Sarkaz.

a.text: 'Medicine and compassion cannot help the Infected in a way that matters, but solidary and strength can.'
Solidarity... solidarity.
Infected have no homeland. We share the same fate, the same sorrow.
These people don't understand... they've never thought about it.
But, what about us?
Will the veterans from Ursus on the team treat the Infected from Kazimierz well? Can Sankta Infected coexist with Sarkaz?
Even at Rhodes Island, I...
What about the future? If we succeed one day, and the Emperor of Ursus vows to stop massacring the Infected, if he agrees to grant us land and cities...
In this beautiful, seemingly impossible future...
Will Reunion, will the Infected, start killing each other?
Will we fracture, collapse, and give them another chance to butcher us?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Hey, Guard, his corpse... it's glowing, he's about to disintegrate!

a.text: I had no idea his condition was so serious.
Or did he really not leave any medicine for himself, trying to save money for some future that would not be his own?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Get out of here! Now!

steps.name: Indifferent Infected
steps.text: Run! Run!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Mays! How do you process the Infected here?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: That room, the innermost one!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Hurry, we have to throw him in there!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Damn it, damn it all... I need a second, protection... for the nose, mouth, and wounds...

a.text: Mays and I lift the Sarkaz's corpse and kick open the door.
Upon opening it, my personal Originium monitor started beeping incessantly. I've never heard the alarm going so intensely before.
Just...
Just how many Infected were processed here?
Every inch of the room is covered with a thick layer of Originium dust, crystal clusters forming in the corners.
'Danger' is no longer sufficient to describe the urgency of the situation.
I don't know when things are going to get out of hand for this place, but... putting a disintegrating Infected in there is definitely not a good idea.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: No good, move, move!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: What are you doing?! Why is the body—

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: There's too much Originium in here. How many Infected have been processed in this room?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I... Well... it was years they were being processed in there!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: There's Originium dust in the air, the place won't survive a violent disintegration!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Get everyone out, now!

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: Wh-What?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Don't you get it? The Originium environment here is extremely unstable. The place could blow at any minute!

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: So we leave? And go where?

steps.name: Frightened Refugee
steps.text: Everything out there is—

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: There's no time!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: We're talking about Reunion here! They have an entire bloody nomadic city!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Run, get them all moving!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I've contacted some of our teams on the outskirts, they'll take some of you in!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Ugh, there's still some booze left in the distillery. If there's an explosion, the whole place is going with it!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: And that—

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Hey, Mays, where are you going?

a.text: The woman dressed in a Reunion uniform is struggling with the machinery in the deepest depths of the workshop.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I'm... Hngh... Help me pull that lever...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Did you work here before? But you're not Infected!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Thanks for not exposing me! Hngh... pull harder!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Where did you get that Reunion outfit?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: This used to be a Reunion base, and so many died here... Don't test my patience!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I... I didn't do anything!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: That's what they all say.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I was... a worker here. That Reunion lot took over the distillery, and they needed hands to run the machines for them.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I... it's just, the mercenaries hired by the lord attacked, and I ran... I'm not Infected, why should I die here with those Reunion?!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: So why did you come back?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Because I had nowhere else to go, dammit! What other reason would I end up trading my life for a secret distillery?!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I'm not Infected, but sometimes I feel like I'd rather be with Reunion! At least they have something to fight against, they have a purpose!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Pull harder! It's stuck!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: First, open the switch for this unloading port. Reunion left behind a whole lot of material!

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: The doctor said this was the cheapest painkiller formula, they were working on it for a long time. It only relieves pain, but that's enough, right?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: With this... can I be a genuine part of Reunion?

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: That is... I might be allowed a home in your nomadic city?

a.text: A nomadic city...
I take a deep breath and throw out a kick. It makes me sore.
The lever finally loosens.
The machine comes to life. The giant hopper tilts to one side and what falls out of it is countless... petals.
She hurriedly picks up the herbs scattered across the ground and carefully piles them in her arms.
If I don't consider where exactly I am, I feel like this could be... a beautiful sight.
Just like that city.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We don't have a city.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: But, those Reunion guys all said—

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: But, you... but...

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: ...Ahah... well...

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: I mean... a nomadic city... a city, you know, we...

a.text: People without a home, people with nowhere to go, the Infected across the world are growing more and more numerous.
It's not that the disease is becoming more virulent, it's just that the world is becoming more cruel.
The great worthies have so much to say about the 'modern' era we live in, an unprecedented era of high-speed battleships, nomadic cities, of industry—
How enlightened our era is—
How tragic our era is.
'Stand together.'
Can the Infected really stand together, naturally?
Who do we stand with? Is it just the Infected?
That... nomadic city we're dreaming of, does it have a place for them?
Is a city enough to accommodate everything?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Take the herbs, we need to leave.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: There is no application to join Reunion. If you're willing to fight side-by-side with us, you're already Reunion.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: But... I'm not Infected.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: It's not only the Infected who want to resist.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: And besides, I need you to help me figure out who killed that Sarkaz man.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: They need to be punished.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Now come on, let's go!

a.text: We make our way quickly through the gigantic tanks, some places have already started collapsing. The air is full of the pungent scent of alcohol, with smoke floating in from somewhere.
This workshop, where the Victorian Reunion began, is about to go up in flames.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We're almost there, quickly now.

a.text: The waves of intense heat hit, Mays struggles to stay standing, the herbs in her arms are lifted by the hot air.

steps.name: Mays
steps.text: Agh! My—

a.text: Above our heads roars the sound of buckling metal.
Well, alright, I push her away.
Then, I jump up with all my strength, and gather up the petals.
A collapse.
It's hot.
The sun is burning. I'm burning.
Is that the exit?
A few steps further.
But they're watching behind me. Those eyes... are they judging me? Or just judging my insignificant death?
What did they expect of me?
I can't think about it... I can't.
Maybe I let them down with their deaths. They should hope for a more meaningful end for me.
Like, I don't know, dying on the steps of the palace in Deity Grypherburg? Anyway, not here, not dying for an uninfected woman I just met, holding some broken petals in my arms.
How could I face them here?
But I still need to face them.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Take them... and go.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: The exit is right ahead, don't lose them this time, I might've... crushed some of the petals, give them to a woman named Nine, she knows what to do.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Don't dawdle, move.

a.text: It's hot. It burns.
I remember the afternoon when I first learned I had Oripathy.
What was it exactly that caused my infection? I still don't actually know.
Maybe it was the time I fell in the river and something scratched my leg. Might've been an active Originium crystal instead of a rock.
Maybe it was the dust I inhaled in the mines.
Maybe it was industrial waste from the factories. Maybe.
But when I got home, the smell of smoke in the room hadn't dissipated. My luggage was packed and placed on the table where we usually ate together.
I found a salt lake, but I wasn't lucky. Maybe I chose the wrong place, there was no boat at the time.
I owe a lot to the Rhodes Island operator who came over and talked to me when I was sitting by the lake.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Nine, Red, Percival, Talulah, guh...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I'm not sure if I'll be burned to cinders by the time you find me, but I hope this recorder survives.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: You ask—

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Are we fighting for all the 'Infected'?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Whether they're despicable, upper class, or even... royalty?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Or... are the people we unite with, the people we want to fight alongside—

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Only the Infected?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Only... them?
